name: AI Helicopter Decelerate No Climbing
intent: Reduce unwanted climb during native AI helicopter braking while preserving useful flight and landing intent.
findings: Source class hooks collect helicopter/VTOL objects; a1-second global PFH selects climb/deceleration/nose-up episodes. Three forward terrain elevations veto selection. No finite episode timeout is evident in readable perFrame.

perFrame applies downward addForce from climbed-height squared, vertical-speed squared, pitch and mass. Actual locality, pilot/player/remote ownership and mission order are not rechecked there. Do not copy stale correction authority.

perSecond refusal removes helisDecel find _heli, while entries are arrays[heli,speed,altitude,time]. In readable SQF that object search cannot match a row and deleteAt -1 can remove an unrelated final row. CBE per-aircraft task identity avoids that method.
Readable enabled_VTOL condition excludes VTOL when true. Retain explicit CBE inclusion semantics. Compiled SQFC/preprocessing equivalence is not established.
